svg.title: One GP1 step as an FSM and a BT
svg.desc: Two panels. Tag 1, left: a state machine drawn as white rounded boxes. read_voltage has an arrow down to pick_from_tester. From pick_from_tester, an arrow labeled in range goes down left to place_in_slot, and an arrow labeled out of range goes down right to recycle_cell. Both have an arrow down to done. Four dashed red arrows, one each from read_voltage, pick_from_tester, place_in_slot and recycle_cell, end at a box named stopped on the right. Tag 2, right: the same step as a behavior tree, indented the way py_trees prints it. The orange box move_cell holds the gray ellipses read_voltage and pick_from_tester and the cyan octagon place_or_recycle. The octagon holds the orange box place_if_good, which holds the gray ellipses voltage_in_range and place_in_slot, and the gray ellipse recycle_cell.
